notes: εἰς ὅ → *whereunto* is one `aligned` unit under rule 35, *where-* answering to the relative and *-unto* to the preposition; headed on the pronominal, and `noncompositional` is refused because part of the English answers to each token.
The three first-person subject pronouns are each kept with the verb whose inflection licenses them (rule 9); only t002 answers to the expressed ἐγώ, so ἐτέθην keeps only its passive auxiliary.
No Greek article stands in the verse, so both English *the* tokens are supplied helpers under rule 51's anarthrous clause.
οὐ is aligned to *not* in the ordinary way; no negative indefinite stands, so rules 41 and 59 do not arise.
